content.title: University of Hawaii Manoa Acceptance Rate, SAT, GPA & ACT Scores
content.text: The University of Hawaii at Manoa (UH Manoa) is a public research university in Honolulu, Hawaii. It serves as the flagship campus of the University of Hawaii System and is highly diversified to accommodate undergraduate and graduate programs in most fields of interest. This is the wonderful University of Hawaii at Manoa with its many programs in academics and a good number of research-based programs. The institution goes one step further in opening doors to students to seek global education and cultural experiences while enabling them to participate in innovative research. Admission to the university is moderately competitive, primarily based on GPA and standardised test scores on the SAT and ACT exams. While the University of Hawaii at Manoa SAT and ACT scores are not mandatory for University of Hawaii at Manoa admissions, submitting them can enhance an applicant's chances. Do you want to improve your SAT Scores? Attempt the SAT Practice Test & Compete with thousands of students. Did You Know Facts About the University of Hawaii at Manoa? Founded: The University of Hawaii at Manoa is the campus of the University of Hawaii system, established in 1907. Enrollment: Home to over 19,000 students, including a diverse mix of international and local students. Campus: Located in Honolulu, students are provided access to research institutions, internships, and career opportunities. Programs: Offers many professional, graduate, and undergraduate programs in many fields, including business, engineering, and ocean sciences. Fee & Step by Step Guide! University of Hawaii at Manoa Admissions RequirementsA strong application to the University of Hawaii at Manoa requires more than high test scores and GPA. The admissions officers will judge on academic qualifications, association with extracurricular involvement, and pursuance of personal achievements. Application to the institution should be made via the official portal of the university before the closure date, including the communication of transcripts, a personal statement, and optional SAT/ACT scores from the University of Hawaii at Manoa. Hawaii University at Manoa follows the holistic admissions method, which includes: Elements Details Application Platform Online application through the University of Hawaii at Manoa website SAT Scores 1130–1350 (optional but recommended) ACT Scores 21–29 (optional) GPA Requirement 3.49–4.04 (recommended) Application Fee $70 Additional Materials Letters of Recommendation: Highlight academic ability and character Extracurricular Activities: Involvement in clubs, sports, or volunteer work Personal Statement: Showcase achievements, aspirations, and reasons for choosing UH Manoa Get to Know the Process on How to Reschedule the SATUniversity of Hawaii at Manoa SAT Score Requirements While the University of Hawaii at Manoa follows a test-optional policy, submitting SAT scores (typically between 1130 and 1350) can strengthen an applicant's profile. The University of Hawaii at Manoa admissions team considers GPA, recommendations, and extracurriculars, but strong SAT scores may enhance scholarship opportunities. Does the University of Hawaii at Manoa Require the SAT? The University of Hawaii at Manoa does not mandate SAT scores for admission. However, students can submit them as an additional measure of academic capability. The SAT assesses critical reading, writing, and math skills, offering a standardised way to compare applicants. University of Hawaii at Manoa Average SAT Scores The University of Hawaii at Manoa does not require taking SAT scores for admission; however, students can submit SAT scores to support their application. The average SAT scores for accepted students are 1240. These scores imply that competitive applicants score above 1240 on the SAT. However, the University of Hawaii at Manoa uses a holistic admissions process. GPA, extracurricular activities, personal statements are considered along with test scores. Students must know that the average SAT score for admitted students at the University of Hawaii at Manoa is around 1240 for University of Hawaii at Manoa admissions. The likelihood of acceptance increases if you score higher than this average. Candidates whose results fall below the 25th percentile should improve their GPAs, personal statements, and extracurricular activities. A score above the 75th percentile increases the likelihood of acceptance. University of Hawaii at Manoa GPA Ranges for Admitted Students A higher GPA significantly improves the chances of admission to the University of Hawaii at Manoa. A GPA of more than 3.5 is desired while taking challenging work. Class rank and overall academic consistency also come into play during a review. A student may concentrate on taking AP, IB, or honours courses to achieve an improved GPA. Admissions officers appreciate students who challenge themselves academically and demonstrate steady improvement. These include: Regents and Presidential Scholarships – Merit-based awards for high-achieving students. UH Opportunity Grant – Need-based financial aid for in-state and out-of-state students. New Warrior Scholarships – Awarded to incoming first-year students based on academic excellence. Departmental Scholarships – Offered by specific colleges within the university. Students should check the UH Manoa Financial Aid Office for eligibility criteria and application deadlines. A balanced method such as strong GPA, competitive SAT scores-if submitted-and an impressive personal statement is what is required for successful admission to a University of Hawaii at Manoa. Knowledge of Manoa GPA and SAT expectations would help applicants to strategically work on their admission profile and elevate acceptance chances.
